video_title: Sam Presti Built OKC for This Exact Moment

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: OKC is a stacked team of young players hungry for opportunity
quotes.excerpt: OKC is a stack team of young players thirsty for opportunity.
quotes.quote: The one thing that I'll say as glass half full is OKC is a stack team of young players thirsty for opportunity. I think their culture is next man up and they're going to continue with that. I don't know how you battle that much, but I think if any team in the NBA has guys stashed away ready to take on this opportunity, I think OKC does.

quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins defends his criticism of Sam Presti regarding Thunder depth
quotes.excerpt: Sam Presti went out and got Jared McCain last year, not for last year, but for this year.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Perk, I'm actually going to come to you on this. Just from a standpoint of last week on NBA Today, you said, quote, 'Sam Presti needs to be investigated. He's running circles around the rest of the league when it comes to the Thunder's depth.' So, I think taking that all into account as well with this process. The inaction action you must take.

text_blocks.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
text_blocks.text: Yeah, he is. So, think about this for a second. Sam Presti went out and got Jared McCain last year, not for last year, but for this year, because he knew he had to move on from pieces. I think we talked about that, we discussed that.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's unique value as an all-NBA and all-defensive player
quotes.excerpt: You can't replace an all-NBA player and an all-defensive player.
quotes.quote: Even with them dealing with the injuries, and I hope Shai Gilgeous-Alexander gets back soon because make no mistake about it, you can't replace an all-NBA player and an all-defensive player. Like, he's one of those guys. I think before he got his money, he made both teams in the same year. He was second team all-defensive team and all-NBA and all that stuff. You can't replace him.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Sam Presti's strategy of drafting and developing talent over trading picks
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to draft the kid by the name of Jalen Williams that's 7'3 that had a double-double.
quotes.quote: The fact that everybody, including myself, the experts always say, 'Hey, Sam Presti, you need to trade some of those picks and you need to go land a big whale and you need to just go out there on the trade market.' He's like, 'Everybody keep calm, keep a cool booty. I'm going to draft the kid by the name of Jalen Williams that's 7'3 that had a double-double the other night. I'm going to draft him, I'm going to put pressure on Chet Holmgren and Isaiah Hartenstein because I got another backup center in Jalen Williams because iron sharpens iron.' So we're loaded at the big position.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: AJ Mitchell's emergence as a starter on a bargain contract
quotes.excerpt: AJ Mitchell is a starter in this league. He had 30 last night.
quotes.quote: AJ Mitchell is making like 3 million dollars or a little over 3 million dollars a year. AJ Mitchell is a starter in this league. He had 30 last night. And I just feel like this opportunity we're still going to look up and we're going to look up at the end in March and April and guess what? They're going to still be a top team in the Western Conference with a winning record because they still got one of the, if not best players in the league, which is the back-to-back MVP in Shai Gilgeous-Alexander.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Why teams hold onto players despite injuries and roster depletion
quotes.excerpt: This is also why you hold them. When your team is depleted, this is why you hold them.
quotes.quote: This is also why you hold them. When your team is depleted, this is why you hold them. You don't necessarily always hold them to go all-in. It's like, what if someone's banged up? What if someone... And again, you save them with all due respect because you have Shai Gilgeous-Alexander. So your window is five, seven years with him. So you don't always want to be like, 'This year we're all-in,' right? And then all of a sudden you have some unforeseen things.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Caris LeVert's recovery and the mental aspect of injury rehabilitation
quotes.excerpt: Caris LeVert had a dislocated ankle. It was really, really bad. But he was able to come back.
quotes.quote: Caris LeVert had a dislocated ankle. It was really, really bad. There were some other things, but he was able to come back that season. He was able to come back that same season. So, you know, maybe this is a situation, and I am not a doctor, but if there isn't ligament damage, and things need to heal. Now there's there's mental, there's a mental aspect to this, don't forget. But if he can heal up, what is to say that he can't be ready in the spring?

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of health and luck in winning an NBA championship
quotes.excerpt: In order to win a championship and get where you're trying to go, you need a lot of luck.
quotes.quote: In order to win a championship and get where you're trying to go, the great Tim Duncan always said, 'You need a lot of luck.' And some of that luck is for other teams not to be healthy, right? Like, that's part of winning a championship. Health comes in. So, I'm not saying that I wish like, no, I want Shai Gilgeous-Alexander on the floor, I want Chet Holmgren on the floor. But if you're Houston and you're Minnesota, because Houston looks outstanding. Now I know it's only an appetizer, but they're deep, they're loaded, they look outstanding.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: The Thunder need to capitalize on early season wins for playoff seeding
quotes.excerpt: It's time for us to capitalize, meaning let's get separation right now.
quotes.quote: It's time for us to capitalize, meaning let's get separation right now. Let's win games early so it don't come back to bite us in the ass in March. Let's try to establish some type of identity where we get home court down the line, we make the playoffs, and we the number one and number two seed to get home court advantage so we could try to get to where the hell we trying to go.
